cmd:
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina
git pull -q origin main 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "=== N8N ==="
python3 scripts/n8n_backup.py 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== RCLONE ==="
R=$(rclone listremotes 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$R" ]; then
  rclone copy docs/ "${R}unitex-docs/" --timeout 120s 2>&1 | tail -3
  echo "тека на Drive: ${R}unitex-docs/"
  rclone lsl "${R}unitex-docs/" 2>&1 | head -5
else
  echo "rclone remote не налаштований"
fi
echo "=== GIT ==="
git add n8n_backup 2>/dev/null
git commit -q -m "n8n: резервна копія воркфлоу (схеми, без доступів)" 2>&1 | tail -2
git push -q origin HEAD:main 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "готово"
